entities.summary: The Athens-Macedonian News Agency (AMNA) is a Greek news agency. It is a public entity anonymous company. It was founded in 2008 as the Athens News Agency - Macedonian Press Agency S.A., under a presidential decree which merged the Athens News Agency and the Macedonian Press Agency.
